title: Preserve live sales demand while approved linked preloading remains
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Extend actual sales order cancellation to reject effective approved nondeleted preloading linked through exact source sales-order detail ids before changing order state. Resolve live current user, sales-order menu and existing customer scope; null legacy links, cancelled/pending/deleted and unrelated preloading do not block. Return actionable preloading reversal requirement without modifying downstream stock, procurement, finance or historical evidence.

Share ERP368 upstream sales-order lock and compatible deterministic lock order with preloading approval/cancellation in one transaction. Actual controller two-connection approval versus source cancellation produces one consistent outcome. Explicit preloading cancellation releases the guard while original history remains; repeat source cancellation retains existing behavior. Failed cancellation preserves entire order/detail/status and existing ERP347 procurement/stock-out/receipt guards. Add actual SQL scenarios for denial, release, null/unrelated links, revoked authorization and race.
